title: Easy breath: /h/
goal: Practise /h/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: Let a gentle breath flow into the vowel. Keep the throat relaxed. Do not scrape the back of your throat.
spelling: h is pronounced in hat, but some words, such as hour, have a silent h.
task: Greet someone and ask how they are. Use an easy breath at the start of hello.
story: A hat is on a chair. Hannah holds the hat.
reviewPrompt: Return to day 10, 17, 21, 23. Recall a word or say one useful phrase before opening those lessons.

articulation.label: hat
articulation.alt: hat: /h/ → /æ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
